title: claude-code fetch_analytics_users
description: One per-user activity row from GET /v1/organizations/analytics/users, stored verbatim as the vendor sent it. Only user.id is checked by the connector; the other properties are typed from the vendor's documentation.

id.description: Anthropic user id. Half of the ExternalID.

last_activity_date.description: Last day the user was active, YYYY-MM-DD (vendor-documented).

rbac_group_id.description: Group id the user belongs to (vendor-documented).

claude_code_metrics.description: Claude Code activity for the day: core_metrics (commit_count, pull_request_count, distinct_session_count, lines_of_code) and tool_actions (accepted_count and rejected_count per tool). Vendor-documented, kept verbatim.

chat_metrics.description: Claude chat activity for the day (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).

office_metrics.description: Office add-in activity for the day, keyed by app (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).

web_search_count.description: Web searches the user ran that day (vendor-documented).
